title: Meals You Can't Miss
editorial: Try a casado early. It became our default: rice, beans, salad, vegetables, fried plantain and a choice of meat.
We liked Soda la Amistad, Sabor Tico and Soda la Coati in Monteverde. In San Jose, we ate at La Criollita and Cafe Rojo.
Costa Rican food is comforting rather than theatrical. If you arrive expecting Mexico-level culinary fireworks, you may miss the point.
